jobs.title: Software Engineer - Apollo Systems
jobs.description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.


The Role
 
Apollo is Palantir’s autonomous software management and deployment platform. It enables seamless, continuous delivery of mission-critical software (Foundry, Gotham, AIP) across a vast range of environments: on-prem, public cloud, disconnected (air-gapped) networks, and highly regulated settings (including IL-5 and FedRAMP).
 
As a Software Engineer on the Apollo team, you’ll build and operate a large-scale distributed system to allow the remote operation and maintenance of Kubernetes clusters. Our mission is to extract the entire state of a cluster into a portable, high-performance artifact within minutes, enabling full and almost instant cluster reconstruction from the ground up—all while pushing the limits of speed, reliability, and scale.
 
You’ll design and implement backup and restore solutions for Kubernetes, leveraging proprietary compression infrastructure tailored to Palantir’s unique deployment models. You’ll also build and optimize our container artifact store, which is based on the OCI (Open Container Initiative) distribution spec—the industry standard for storing and distributing container images and artifacts. You’ll own the backbone of every environment Apollo supports, from hyperscalers to Army trucks.
 
If you’re excited by challenges at the intersection of container technologies like OCI and docker, storage, and distributed systems, you’ll find opportunities here to dive deep into storage formats and low-level optimizations, where milliseconds matter. As we increasingly automate cluster creation and management on diverse hardware, you’ll play a key role in scaling Palantir’s presence at the edge and solving tough distributed systems problems. You’ll own the full development lifecycle—from idea generation and design, through implementation, to operation and support—while collaborating closely with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver robust, impactful infrastructure. The usage of AI tools (Claude Code/Codex/Copilot) is highly encouraged!

jobs.title: Social Comms
jobs.description:
Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr

NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce.

Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that.

The Social Comms role: We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment.

As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. You're a pundit, optimist, skeptic, researcher and writer all rolled into one.Â 

The measure of your work would be whether the right people are actually engaging: researchers, builders, journalists, policymakers, and the ordinary users who sense something is off. No growth-hacking or engagement bait please. We would rather stay small and authoritative than sound like a brand. The work is async, any timezone, and you'd have direct access to the passionate team and to everything we publish before it's public.

You will have a significant say and authorship of our blog (nascent stages still), linkedin, other social accounts, public spaces, and private community spaces that you recommend. Anything relevant to our work.

You'd be a great fit if

  • You care deeply about what AI is doing to human relationships and social norms; you're concerned and curious.
  • You understand how LLMs work at an abstract level and the flaws they have.
  • You've run or grown popular social accounts before.
  • You write like a person, and you don't lean on AI to think or post for you.
  • You can read a piece of research and find the three lines people will actually care about.
  • You can disagree with strangers thoughtfully in public, critics included.
  • You have a feel for which channels matter, and which ones aren't worth our time.
  • You have experience in civic domains, public-good, policy, trust-and-safety, or non-profits.

Bonus: you have already published material relevant to AI and its proliferation and risks.

Responsibilities



Reception & Client Communication

* Answer high-volume inbound phone calls across multiple lines and route calls appropriately
* Take detailed notes and messages while ensuring accurate communication with attorneys and staff
* Professionally communicate with prospective and existing clients regarding their legal matters
* Conduct initial client screening and gather relevant information
* Serve as the primary point of contact for callers and provide exceptional client service
* Make outbound calls on behalf of attorneys as needed

Calendar & Administrative Support

* Schedule consultations, appointments, and meetings while maintaining multiple calendars
* Enter and track important court dates, deadlines, appointments, and client communications
* Provide timely reminders to attorneys and staff regarding upcoming deadlines and events
* Maintain accurate contact records and client information databases
* Assist with general administrative and office support functions

Legal Documentation & Case Support

* Assist with document preparation, correspondence, and client communications
* Scan, organize, label, and file legal and administrative documents
* Preserve and maintain updated case records and filing systems
* Assist with legal filings and e-filings as needed
* Summarize documents and draft basic correspondence for attorney review
* Conduct documentary and statistical research when requested

Records Management & Data Entry

* Maintain organized digital client files and records
* Input information into Excel spreadsheets, billing systems, and case management software
* Source and verify important case information and documentation
* Ensure confidentiality and accuracy when handling sensitive client information
* Support attorneys and staff with case-related administrative projects

Qualifications

* Minimum of 2 years of receptionist experience required, preferably within a law firm
* Legal receptionist experience strongly preferred
* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail
* Ability to manage high call volume while maintaining professionalism and accuracy
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong calendaring and scheduling experience
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite required
* Experience with legal technology, court-filing systems, or case management software preferred
* Experience with MyCase, RingCentral, Microsoft Word, and Excel is a plus
* Outstanding time management and multitasking abilities
* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred
* Mandarin proficiency is a plus
* Cantonese proficiency is a plus
